name: view_difficulty_words_stay_put
description: The level's words stand still under the pointer (playtest halv s2, P9, f343 to f407, shot 0177: a click on Hard lengthened the mode line to 'High Water · Hard · ...', the words beside it slid right, and the pointer ended on Normal, whose tooltip showed, so a second click would have undone the pick). The mode line is now as wide as the widest line it can say (HubPanel._widest_mode_text, every mode at every level), so a click on any of the three words, or on another mode, leaves every word where it stood, and the pointer that clicked Hard still hovers Hard. Without the fix Hard moved 36 px right and the pointer hovered Normal.

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal (lit) | Hard | Very Hard' and node('ModeLine').text == 'High Water · 1–4 players · 12 waves'
steps.msg: offline at Normal: the mode line names no level

steps.assert: Session.difficulty_id() == 'hard' and node('ModeLine').text == 'High Water · Hard · 1–4 players · 12 waves'
steps.msg: the click picks Hard, and the mode line names it
every level's word stands where it stood
the pointer that clicked Hard still hovers Hard, not Normal

steps.assert: Session.difficulty_id() == 'very_hard' and node('ModeLine').text == 'High Water · Very Hard · 1–4 players · 12 waves' and [node('Level_normal').get_global_rect(), node('Level_hard').get_global_rect(), node('Level_very_hard').get_global_rect()] == before
steps.msg: Very Hard, the longest word in the line, moves nothing either

steps.assert: node('ModeLine').text == 'Tide Race · Very Hard · 2–4 players · 12 waves' and [node('Level_normal').get_global_rect(), node('Level_hard').get_global_rect(), node('Level_very_hard').get_global_rect()] == before

steps.msg: the line and the words stand apart, clear of the card wing
and back to Normal, the words still where they stood
